output.reason: On its own, [ev-a4ab17efb447] is just a list item with the metric name. The section intro [ev-1f419676f177] makes it concrete: in 3.0.0, metrics listed there that start with `cortex_` (this one included) will now start with `loki_`. So `cortex_prometheus_rule_group_rules` becomes `loki_prometheus_rule_group_rules`. The same text says who is affected: environments that leave `metrics_namespace` at its default of `loki`. Setting it to `cortex` keeps the old prefix. For affected environments, anything that queries the `cortex_` name will no longer find the metric under that name. That is enough to write the subject, change, applicability and consequence.
